name: meta
description: Work with Claude Code itself: choose the model for each stage, author skills, and review any plugin for drift, with a hook that captures skill gaps as they surface.

feedback.title: Skill feedback destination
feedback.description: Where Claude records a skill gap it hits: issues (a GitHub issue on the owning plugin's repository), file (~/.claude/skill-feedback.md, for a machine whose work must not reach a public tracker) or off.
